The Last Heartbeat.description: Bring the Heartstone from the Chapel of the Long Wake down to the door of Aldrumm's heart and set it in the hand-shaped lock to seal the Carrion Queen out forever, before she forces the door.
locations: The Chapel of the Long Wake

events.event: COMPLETED: Dawn, 7th of Harvestwane: Pip spoke the tutored hearth-word over the Heartstone in the hand-shaped lock, with Gristle sharing the bill and Aldrumm sharing it too. The heart's door is sealed forever. The Carrion Queen can never come in that way again.
